record.name: Cape Verde
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The government plans a National AI Strategy and a Digital and AI Centre of Excellence for skills; neither has an evaluation mandate.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The preserved government brochure describes the AI strategy and digital/AI centre of excellence as skills, talent and ecosystem initiatives. Its description does not establish the qualifying remit to evaluate advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

searches.query: Cape Verde national AI safety security institute advanced model evaluation proposal government

check.language_note: The recorded pt query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The government programme commits to national AI strategy development and an AI/digital skills centre; the proposed centre is not described as an evaluator of advanced models.
